title: Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y Gastric Bypass
source: CMS National Coverage Determination style criteria (synthetic) + Plan Medical Policy

required_documentation.description: Documented BMI, either >= 40, or >= 35 with a qualifying comorbidity.
Participation in a physician-supervised weight management program, typically 3-6 months, within the last 2 years.
A psychological/behavioral health evaluation clearing the patient for bariatric surgery.

criteria: BMI >= 40, OR BMI >= 35 with at least one qualifying comorbidity (e.g., type 2 diabetes, hypertension, obstructive sleep apnea).
Completion of a physician-supervised weight management program (nutrition counseling, documented attempts at weight loss) within the past 2 years.
A psychological evaluation has cleared the patient for surgery, with no untreated eating disorder or unmanaged severe psychiatric illness noted.
Prior non-surgical weight-loss attempts have been insufficient to achieve or maintain a healthy weight given the patient's comorbidities.
No absolute contraindication to bariatric surgery (e.g., active substance use disorder, unmanaged bleeding disorder) documented.
notes: Synthetic policy created for this demo; not an actual CMS NCD or plan policy.
